notes: Spellbreak (Proletariat) Trail_Fill (/Game/VFX/Cosmetics/CloudBurst/Pyromancer): root + 8 instances, all BLEND_Translucent / MSM_DefaultLit / one-sided, so the shader is not a template. 33 enabled emitters in 28 effects use it, all of them velocity-aligned mesh emitters on FX_Oblong_A/_AZ/_B/_C (afterglow 'Glow Outer mesh', cloudburst 'MeshBKeeP', Spellstorm beacon 'GlowHot'/'Core Vert Glow'). EVIDENCE: the scalars Emissive Intesity, Frenel Outer Edge, Edge Min/Max, Erosion Scale, erosion Contrast, erosion PreMultiply, U/V Pan, Panner FPS, Rotate, WPO Intensity, Camera Close Start/length and Depth Fade Distance; the compiled FUniformExpressionSet of every inline shader map (root + all 9 instance maps) reads exactly these plus RefractionDepthBias, with the folded forms (0 - erosion Contrast), (erosion Contrast + 1) (CheapContrast = lerp(-C, 1 + C, x)) and max(Depth Fade Distance, 1e-5) (engine DepthFade), Rotate only in the Has Rotate = true root map, and Frenel Outer Edge read before Edge Min/Max; the scalar node 'Fill GlowIntensity' (default 0.1, never overridden) survives as an export but is absent from every compiled map (root, all instances, and the sibling copies StormE_Fill_FxM and M_DeathlyDescent_Trail_Fill). A UE4.22 parameter that reaches an active output always compiles to a uniform expression, Has Rotate is the only static switch and CachedQualityLevelsUsed is the no-quality-switch default, so that node is unconnected (or feeds only an inactive input), has no in-game effect and is NOT used; the switch Has Rotate; DynamicParameter [Erosion, Edge Softness, Fill Glow intensity, Param4] with defaults (1, 0.05, 0.1, 1); calls to MF_PannerRotatorFPS, CheapContrast, MF_TransluscentToonErosion, SmoothStep and CameraDepthFade; one fixed TextureSample T_f_Distortion_A (grey veins, SRGB false, viewed); EmissiveColor and WPO input entries; no vector or texture params, so the colour is the particle colour. Sibling copies of this graph: StormE_Fill_FxM adds FresnelFrac + Fr2Edge Min/Max, which shows that Edge Min/Max is a SmoothStep on a Fresnel whose exponent is 'Frenel Outer Edge'; M_DeathlyDescent_Trail_Fill splits Erosion Scale into X/Y, which makes it UV tiling. Emitter curves: dyn Erosion 1->0.5 / 0.7->0.5 / 0.7->0 / constant 1, Edge Softness 1 (glows) or 0.05 (Trail_Fill), Fill Glow 0->0.97->0 (Trail_Fill_Glow, WingsGlow), 0->0.2->0 (the other glow instances and the root EmeraldPlunge/FrostBorn emitters) or 0->0.5->0 (root Toxic emitters); particle alpha bells peak between 0.05 and 1. AUTHORED: (1) MF_PannerRotatorFPS = global TIME stepped at Panner FPS, UV*Erosion Scale + (U,V Pan)*t, plus a rotation about the centre when Has Rotate is set (Rotate is 0 everywhere, read as rad/s). (2) Fresnel uses UE's default base reflect 0.04. (3) shape = mix(fill, 1, SmoothStep(EdgeMin, EdgeMax, fresnel)), where fill = the dyn 'Fill Glow intensity' alone (its default 0.1 equals the dangling scalar's, so it reads as that scalar's per-particle replacement, used as a fill level); the mix() combination is authored. (4) toon erosion: saturate((saturate(shape*CheapContrast(tex)*PreMultiply) - (1-dynErosion)) / clamp(dynEdgeSoftness, 0.01, 1)). Evidence: m_TornadoSimple (DynamicParameter 'Erosion' + 'Is particle' switch) compiles (1 - Texture Erosion) and clamp(Edge Softness, 0.01, 1), and every material that feeds MF_TransluscentToonErosion's softness from a scalar compiles the same clamp (M_SphereErosion, M_SphereErosion_SoftEdge, ReaperScythe_FxM, TrailInk_FxM, CenserOfEenlightenment01_FxM); the ramp form itself is authored. (5) particle alpha is a plain opacity multiplier, and emissive = particle colour * Emissive Intesity. The shader is unshaded because the base colour is assumed black: the source is DefaultLit but drives only EmissiveColor. (6) WPO = a world-space push of WPO Intensity cm toward the camera, which keeps glow shells in front of the caster. A noise inflate would tear the 6 cm-thin spawn shells. (7) Depth Fade Distance is UE DepthFade, applied as stored, including the 2500 cm on Darkness/HolyLight/DireMalady/MercilessLunge. In the lab, ground about 3 m behind multiplies those to roughly 0.1 opacity, so the black Darkness and HolyLight glows are faint (they were faint grey before as well). KNOWN GAP: FX_Oblong_B carries a vertex-alpha gradient. Godot multiplies it into COLOR for MultiMesh, while UE mesh particles may ignore mesh vertex colour. That is shared-runtime behaviour and is not handled here.
